EmailTemplate.description: For use by the Admission Services App Services team
EmailTemplate.name: Transfer Credit Inquiry (Advisor - Transferred)
EmailTemplate.subject: Your student’s case has been transferred
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for contacting Arizona State University’s Admission Services about your student’s transfer credits. We’ve confirmed that the transfer credits are displaying correctly in our system and transferred this case to another department for review.
If you have additional questions, you can reach out to the appropriate department:
Academic Articulation department at articulation@asu.edu University Registrar Services at courses@asu.edu
You can monitor the progress of the transfer credit correction on the student’s case history in Salesforce.
Thank you,
Admission Services transfercredit@asu.edu
If you would like any additional information or have questions related to this subject, please reply to this email.
{!Case.Thread_Id}
